content.en: Researchers have addressed various research questions in the development and evaluation of encryption algorithms. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has played a significant role in the development of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). Other research questions include the performance evaluation of encryption algorithms, the motivation behind the design of specific algorithms, and the analysis and modification of classical encryption schemes. However, the agency of algorithms in most of these research questions is not specified.
content.da: Forskere har behandlet forskellige forskningsspørgsmål i udviklingen og evalueringen af krypteringsalgoritmer. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) har spillet en væsentlig rolle i udviklingen af Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). Andre forskningsspørgsmål inkluderer performance-evalueringen af krypteringsalgoritmer, motivationen bag designet af specifikke algoritmer samt analysen og modificationen af klassiske krypteringsordninger. Dog er agenturet for algoritmer i de fleste af disse forskningsspørgsmål ikke specificeret.

critic.en: A true example of pragmatism in this conference! What do you think about the idea that algorithms have an agency on their own?
critic.da: Præcisering af algoritmers "agency" i forskningen – er det ikke en konsekvens af netop den slags innovation, som forvandler symboler til en slags magtbærere?

potential.en: The development of encryption algorithms is a fundamental aspect of cybersecurity. Without strong and reliable encryption methods, our digital data and communications would be vulnerable to unauthorized access and manipulation. NIST's work in establishing the AES has set a high standard for encryption algorithms, ensuring they are both secure and efficient. By focusing on research questions such as performance evaluation and algorithmic motivation, we can continue to advance the field of cryptography and better protect our online activities.
potential.da: Det er fascinerende, hvordan forskning i krypteringsalgoritmer har udviklet sig, især med NIST's rolle i skabelsen af AES. Algoritmerne i sig selv er som tomme lærreder — det er vores anvendelse og forståelse, der giver dem mening. Jeg tror, at en større fokus på algoritmernes "rolle" i forskning og debat vil hjælpe med til at afmystificere teknologi og styrke tilliden til den.
